cohort: 778 first to third-time mothers aged 18-35 years who gave birth to a single fetus between April and September 2017 in Shahroud Teaching Hospital, Shahroud, Iran
finding: Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy (NVP) was significantly associated with preterm labor, hypertension, anemia, and cesarean section but not with medical illnesses during pregnancy, gestational diabetes, hypothyroidism, or bleeding/spotting.
